Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Face: a real photograph of a real Korean woman's face, not an illustration and not a CG render — visible pores and fine skin grain, the fine natural expression lines of her age around the eyes and mouth, faint peach-fuzz hairs catching the light, natural tonal variation with a soft flush on the cheeks, a few small natural beauty marks, slight natural asymmetry, eyes with real wet catchlights and individual lashes, lips with real vertical texture — never airbrushed, never smooth like plastic.
